req.title: PUT rejects squadNumber conflict
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 409 when the updated squadNumber collides with another player's squadNumber.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should return an HTTP 409 status code when a PUT request attempts to update a player's squad number to one that already exists. This ensures data integrity by preventing duplicate squad numbers. The test suite includes a positive test to verify successful updates without conflicts, a negative test to check for proper conflict handling, and a boundary test to ensure edge cases are handled correctly.

tests.name: test_put_update_no_conflict
preconditions: Player with squad number 27 does not exist
actions: Send PUT request to update player with squad number 1 to squad number 27
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

player_data = {
    "firstName": "Franco",
    "middleName": "Daniel",
    "lastName": "Armani",
    "dateOfBirth": "1986-10-16T00:00:00.000Z",
    "squadNumber": 27,
    "position": "Goalkeeper",
    "abbrPosition": "GK",
    "team": "River Plate",
    "league": "Copa de la Liga",
    "starting11": False
}

response = client.put("/players/squadnumber/1", json=player_data)
assert response.status_code == 204

tests.name: test_put_update_conflict
actions: Send PUT request to update player with squad number 1 to squad number 2
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

player_data = {
    "firstName": "Franco",
    "middleName": "Daniel",
    "lastName": "Armani",
    "dateOfBirth": "1986-10-16T00:00:00.000Z",
    "squadNumber": 2,
    "position": "Goalkeeper",
    "abbrPosition": "GK",
    "team": "River Plate",
    "league": "Copa de la Liga",
    "starting11": False
}

response = client.put("/players/squadnumber/1", json=player_data)
assert response.status_code == 409
assert response.json() == {"detail": "A Player with this squad number already exists."}
